record_scope_reconstruction: Limited goods/person passage at the El Beid road bridge joining Fotokol and Gambaru. The contemporary source describes transshipment on selected days, not fully restored loaded-truck passage.

source_checks.finding: Contemporary Cameroon Tribune reporting reproduced here identifies the 141 m El Beid bridge; the local official explains goods crossed by carts, bicycles and porters on Monday/Wednesday/Saturday, while loaded trucks did not cross.
Later ISS retrospective describes a 2021 reopening; it is not allowed to erase the separately documented limited 2016 passage.
